name: Kita Kenta
source:
Born on October 7, 1989.
Due to his small build, he is nicknamed "Chibita." He is constantly bullied by Iwaki Ryuji, and although he believes that one day he will return the favor, he has resigned himself to the bullying. As a result, he admires heroes and wishes for them to exist.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
